about.title: About Us
about.intro: Jobsoccer is the recruitment platform built specifically for soccer.
about.p1: Using AI-powered matching, video analysis and performance data, we help employers hire faster and more efficiently, while giving candidates worldwide the visibility and fair chance they deserve.
about.p2: Clubs, academies, schools, universities and agents post jobs and search candidates. Players, coaches and office staff build a profile, record a video interview and get discovered.
about.p3: Every candidate for the same position answers the same questions, so everyone is evaluated on equal terms. The AI assessment supports, and never replaces, the employer's own judgment.

quality.q: What is the Profile Quality Score?
quality.a: A score out of 100 that shows how complete, verified and up to date your profile is. You see the number; employers see stars and a level. It does not measure your professional ability.

video.a: You answer the same set of questions as every other candidate for your position, in one video of up to 6:30 minutes. The answers are transcribed, summarised and scored by AI to help employers review them. Scores support, and never replace, the employer's judgment.

methodology.a: No, it is optional for on-field and office staff. Adding it gives you extra Profile Quality points and helps you stand out.

requirements.a: MP4 or MOV, at least 720p, up to 600 MB, recorded with a fixed camera in a quiet place. You may record your answers separately and combine them into one video before uploading.

replace.a: Your interview and methodology videos are locked for 3 months after you submit them. After that you can upload an updated version.

contact.q: Who can see my contact details?
contact.a: Employers see your contact details only after you accept their access request.

verified.a: Use "Add Verification Badge" on your profile to request identity verification, and upload a document for your licences, education or work history. Verified items add points to your score.

contact.title: Contact
contact.intro: Questions, feedback or need help with your profile? We are happy to help.
contact.accessibility: Candidates who need an adjustment for accessibility reasons when recording their video can also contact us at the same address.
